system.description:
Weapon Kit — A melee mace that builds Charged, with shock, arc and discharge options.

Strike (basic) — 1 Action · Considered a mace. Reach 1, Damage: 2d6+STR Lightning. You have advantage if you are Charged. On crit: gain Charged.

Toolbelt (2 Actions):

  • System Shock. Reach 1, Damage: 2d6+STR Lightning, lose Charged. If you lost Charged, the target must make a STR save or be Stunned. On a save, they are Dazed, 1 turn.
  • Arc Leap. Range 6. Gain Charged. Teleport to a spot in Range, then Burst 1, Damage: 2d6. Ignores armor.
  • Discharge. Reach 1, Damage: 2d6 Lightning, lose Charged. If you lose Charged, deal damage in Burst 2 instead. Ignores armor; can still crit or miss.

High Levels: +6 damage every 5 levels (Strike, System Shock). +4 damage every 5 levels (Arc Leap, Discharge).

[M] Weapon Kits are considered weapons for swapping and stowing. The basic ability costs 1 Action; each Toolbelt option costs 2 Actions and 1 Toolbelt scrap. Scrap cost is tracked by the module.
